description.zh: 产品类型，目前仅支持**ANT_CLOUD_AUTH**（金融级实人），其他均退市。
description.en: The product type. Currently, only **ANT_CLOUD_AUTH** (financial-grade real-person authentication) is supported. All other types have been discontinued.
